quote: Nobody we interviewed would pay more than $10.
note: Only 6 interviews though. Is that enough to set a price on?

replies.text: Enough to see a pattern, not to pick a number. A cheap next step: ask the next 20 people the four Van Westendorp questions (too cheap / a bargain / getting expensive / too expensive). It gives you a range instead of one anchor.

quote: Ford's catch: it only works if volume can grow a lot. Can ours?
note: Our market is maybe 40k teams. Ford had every family in America. Different game?

replies.text: Probably a smaller version of the same game. At $10 instead of $24 you need 2.4× the customers for the same revenue. The question for your note: can 40k teams give you 2.4× more buyers at $10? If yes, Ford's order works; if not, the cut only lowers revenue.
